columns.name: Facility Name
columns.description: Legal name of the licensed Home Health Agency as recorded by IDPH. May include a "DBA" (doing business as) trade name where the agency operates under a name different from its legal entity name.

columns.name: Address
columns.description: Street address of the agency's licensed parent location. Suite or building numbers are included where applicable. Branch offices and drop-sites are not separately listed; an agency's licensed service area may include locations served from branch offices not visible in this dataset.

columns.name: City
columns.description: Municipality of the agency's licensed parent location.

columns.name: County
columns.description: Illinois county of the agency's licensed parent location. The agency's approved geographic service area typically extends beyond this single county; consult IDPH for full service area details.

columns.name: Zip
columns.description: Five-digit U.S. Postal Service ZIP code of the agency's licensed parent location.

columns.name: Contact Name
columns.description: Primary administrative contact at the agency, designated for IDPH correspondence. Typically the agency administrator or supervising nurse.

columns.name: Phone
columns.description: Main published telephone number for the agency, including area code. Format: (XXX) XXX-XXXX.

columns.name: License Number
columns.description: License number issued by the Illinois Department of Public Health authorizing the agency to operate as a Home Health Agency under 77 Ill. Adm. Code 245. This is the state license number only; CMS certification numbers (CCN) for Medicare-participating agencies are issued separately and are not included in this dataset.

columns.name: Exp. Date
columns.description: Date on which the agency's current IDPH license expires. Agencies must submit a renewal application prior to this date to maintain authority to operate. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
